verdict.rationale: telli's first-party docs describe webhooks that push real-time call events, status changes and outcomes to a user-configured endpoint via POST requests. This meets the requirement for registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. missing for 10: a documented list of event types and payload schemas, signature verification or retry details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: When something happens on a call, telli sends a POST request to the endpoint you configure
Webhooks: Receive real-time notifications about call events, status changes, and outcomes.
